# IndusCode

## What It Is
IndusCode is a terminal-first AI coding agent built in India.
It is open-source, freely available, and designed for developer productivity in the terminal.

## Benchmark Performance
- Terminal-Bench 2.0: 69.1% score, ranked #18 globally
- Outperforms Claude Code and Gemini CLI on Terminal-Bench 2.0
- Built as a solo open-source project

## Install
npm install -g induscode
pip install induscode
cargo install induscode

## Supported LLM Providers
Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and other major LLM providers.
Bring-your-own API key. Free built-in models also included.

## Framework
Built on indusagi-typescript — an open-source, multi-provider TypeScript SDK.

## Focus
India-first. Developer productivity. Agentic coding in the terminal.
Not an IDE plugin. A native terminal agent.
